info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Loan Application By Collateral Id-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access specific loan application details based on a collateral ID. It is designed for financial institutions and business analysts looking to assess loan data linked to collateral assets. By querying the loan applications using both the loan application identifier and the collateral ID, users can efficiently retrieve essential information that supports financial decision-making and risk assessment. Typical consumers include loan officers, credit analysts, and financial application developers.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the collateral information associated with a specific loan application. It provides details necessary for evaluating the loan's backing assets.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve details about the collaterals associated with the specified loan application. It specifies the necessary structure that the client must follow to appropriately request the collateral information.

200.description: Returns the details of the specified collateral for the loan application.

GetLoanApplicationByCollateralIdRequest.description: Request body schema for retrieving loan application collaterals.

collateralType.description: The type of collateral being used.

ownershipType.description: The type of ownership associated with the collateral.

ownerCustomerIds.description: List of customer IDs that own the collateral.

description.description: A brief description of the collateral.

marketValue.description: The current market value of the collateral.

forcedSaleValue.description: The estimated value of the collateral if sold under duress.

valuationDate.description: The date on which the collateral was last valued.

valuationProvider.description: The entity that provided the valuation of the collateral.

lienPriority.description: The priority of the lien on the collateral.

id.description: The unique identifier for the collateral.

status.description: The current status of the collateral in the application process.

loanToValuePercent.description: The loan-to-value ratio expressed as a percentage.

perfectedAt.description: The date when the lien was perfected.

audit.description: Audit information related to the collateral.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the collateral.

GetLoanApplicationByCollateralIdResponse.description: Schema representing the details of a collateral in a loan application.

currency.description: The currency in which the value is expressed.

amount.description: The numerical amount of the value.

Value.description: Schema representing a monetary value with associated currency.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the collateral record was created.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the collateral record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the collateral record was last updated.

updatedBy.description: The user or system that last updated the collateral record.

version.description: The version of the collateral record.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for a collateral record.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response generated.

correlationId.description: An identifier used for tracking the request across services.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the collateral information was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographical region where the collateral information was processed.

MetadataInfo.description: Schema representing additional metadata for a collateral record.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: An identifier for the endpoint that processed the request. This value can be used for tracking and debugging purposes.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the request, which can be useful for monitoring application performance.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes Bearer Authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header to access protected resources.
